report.explanation: Current evidence shows healthy checkout: order trace OK at 67ms, gateway 200, payment error_rate 0.001 with zero timeouts and zero db pool waiters. The order deployment (3.1.5, 1605 min old) cannot establish causality. No observation supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate can be substantiated; hand off for the missing per-service telemetry.
